usage.title: Usage
providers.title: AI providers
providers.explain: OpenAI-compatible model providers for the Main Agent, custom agents and flows, tried in this order when one fails. Each maps model aliases (small, large, …) to the provider's model names.
providers.mainHint: Automatic sends build or change requests and long questions to large, the rest to small.
providers.caption: Providers in failover order
providers.modelsHint: One alias=model per line, e.g. large=claude-opus. Aliases: lower-case letters, digits, - and _.
providers.keyHint: The name of a platform secret holding the API key (none: no key, http:// local models only). The key itself never shows here.
providers.none: No providers yet: agents use the server's default model, or each person's ChatGPT link.
tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.explain: Each tenant's time zone and display currency are the defaults of its projects; a project can set its own in its Changes tab.
tenants.help: Time zone: an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin (empty: UTC). Currency: an ISO code such as EUR (empty: none).
locale.title: Time zone and currency
locale.invalid: no valid time zone: project.json holds an unknown one, set it here
locale.currencyFormat: Three capital letters, an ISO 4217 code such as EUR
locale.projectHelp: Empty uses the tenant's value, else UTC and no display currency. Day boundaries and time intelligence follow the time zone; CONVERT in measures converts into the display currency with the rates table.
locale.editorsOnly: Only Editors and Owners can change these settings.
delivery.title: Email and channels
delivery.help: Where this project's emails and channel posts go (send_email, post_message, flows and tasks). The in-app inbox needs nothing here.
delivery.ownersOnly: Only Owners can change where this project sends.
delivery.secretFormat: The name of a secret: letters, digits and _
delivery.smtpHelp: Empty host: no email. The password is the name of a secret, never the password itself; the secret's allowed hosts must hold the mail server's host.
delivery.name: Name
delivery.urlHelp: An https:// URL whose token part is a secret: ${secret:NAME}. The secret's allowed hosts must hold the URL's host.

usage.noLlm: No AI calls in this period.

newProject.name: Name

newProject.made: Project {project} is ready. Next, load data into it.
addData.title: Add data
addData.noProject: There is no project you can load data into yet. Create one first.
addData.fileHint: CSV, Excel (.xlsx), Parquet or JSON. Types, keys and dates are detected for you.
addData.advancedHint: Only for CSV files that don't load as they are. Auto leaves the choice to detection.
addData.lenient: Read rows that break the CSV rules (e.g. text after a closing quote)
addData.portHint: Empty: the default port (5432 PostgreSQL, 3306 MySQL).
addData.secretsHint: Logins come from stored secrets, never typed here; a workspace owner stores them.
addData.noSecrets: This project has no secrets yet. Ask a workspace owner to store the database login as secrets.
addData.incrementalHint: A column that only grows (an ID or timestamp): daily refreshes then load only new rows.
addData.tableHint: Letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _. Loading into an existing table replaces its data.
addData.locationHint: A file under the server's files folder (sales/2026.parquet), all files of a folder (sales/*.parquet), a Delta or Iceberg folder, or an http:// or https:// address of a file.
addData.s3Hint: s3://bucket/path to a file, a folder of files (s3://bucket/sales/*.parquet) or a Delta or Iceberg folder.
addData.formatHint: Auto reads it from the file extension, or from a folder's _delta_log (Delta) or metadata (Iceberg).
addData.endpointHint: host or host:port of an S3-compatible server such as MinIO, without http://. Empty: Amazon S3.
addData.urlVhost: Virtual host (bucket in the host name)
addData.plainHttp: Plain HTTP, no TLS (local test servers only)
addData.s3SecretsHint: Keys come from stored secrets, never typed here. Leave both on None for a public bucket.
addData.clickhouseHint: ClickHouse tables are queried in place, live: nothing is copied, and every question reads the current data.
addData.chPortHint: Empty: the default HTTP port (8123, or 8443 with HTTPS).
addData.sync: Let Owners write edits back to this table (the login then needs UPDATE, INSERT and DELETE rights)
addData.apiHint: An https:// address. It is loaded daily (or on the schedule below) and must reach a public host.
addData.apiRecordsHint: JSON pointer to the list of records in each response, such as /data/items. Empty: the whole response is the list.
addData.apiClientIdHint: Public: the browser shows it to the provider.
addData.oauth.none: Not connected. Connect, then load within 10 minutes.
addData.oauth.connected: Connected. Load within 10 minutes to keep the connection.
addData.oauth.stale: The connection expired before the source was saved. Connect again.
addData.oauth.expired: The connect link expired. Connect again.
addData.oauth.browser: The connection was started in another browser. Connect again here.
addData.oauth.denied: The provider did not grant access.
addData.oauth.role: You need the editor role in this project to connect a source.
addData.oauth.failed: The provider refused the connection. Check the URLs and the client.
addData.oauth.no_refresh: The provider gave no refresh token, so later loads could not sign in. Ask for offline access in the scope.
addData.apiPagePointer: Pointer to the next cursor or link
addData.apiIncrementalHint: Sends the largest loaded value of the field as the query parameter and appends what comes back.
addData.apiColumnsHint: Columns you name get this type (such as BIGINT, DECIMAL(10,2), DATE); a JSON pointer picks a nested field. Other columns are detected.

confirm.rename_project: Rename this project? Its files, records and data move to the new name. {details}
confirm.delete_secret: Delete this secret? Anything that still needs it stops working.
confirm.delete_llm_provider: Remove this LLM provider? Agents stop using it.
confirm.forget: Delete this memory entry? This can't be undone.
confirm.remove_relationship: Delete this relationship? Queries can no longer combine these tables through it.
confirm.delete_glossary_term: Delete this glossary term? It is unlinked from the project memory too.
confirm.delete_flow: Delete this flow? Its run history stays.
confirm.delete_ml_model: Delete this ML model? Its training runs stay.
confirm.use_ml_trial: Train this ML model with this trial's setting from now on, without a search? {details}
confirm.delete_table: Delete this table? Its data is archived for 30 days. {details}
confirm.delete_source: Delete this source? Its data is archived for 30 days. {details}
confirm.delete_tenant: Delete this tenant? This can't be undone.
confirm.set_project_tenant: Move this project to another tenant? {details}
confirm.set_delivery: Change where this project sends emails and posts? {details}
confirm.delete_agent: Delete this agent and its evaluation questions?
confirm.delete_oidc_provider: Remove this sign-in provider? People linked to it can no longer sign in through it.
confirm.delete_chat: Delete this chat? This can't be undone.
confirm.remove_role: Remove this person's role? They lose access to the project.
confirm.delete_user: Delete this account with its sessions and roles? This can't be undone.
confirm.set_workspace_owner: Change who is a workspace owner? A workspace owner is Owner in every project.
confirm.reset_mfa: Turn off this account's two-step sign-in and sign it out everywhere?
